描述_EN: the ‘creeper’ is a hostile character encountered in the minecraft world. minecraft was created by swedish games designer markus ‘notch’ persson. the sprite has become the most recognisable and marketable character, and is usually seen as the mascot of the series. it attacks the player by creeping up on them, then exploding. at its most basic, it is a first-person, open-world sandbox game, in which players build constructions out of textured cubes.
描述_ZN: "爬行者 "是在Minecraft世界中遇到的一个敌对角色。 Minecraft是由瑞典游戏设计师Markus 'notch' Persson创造的。 该精灵已成为最易识别和最有市场的角色，并且通常被视为该系列的吉祥物。 它通过爬上玩家，然后爆炸来攻击他们。 最基本的是，它是一个第一人称的开放世界沙盒游戏，玩家在其中用有纹理的立方体建造建筑。
